slides.texte_overlay:
7 ways to become a new
man in just six months
Fix your sleep before anything else. Same bedtime, dark room, no phone in bed. Six months of good sleep changes your energy, your mood and even your face.
Learn to cook healthy food you enjoy. Five go-to meals that are quick and good. Your body and your wallet will both look different by spring.
Get stronger every month. Add a little weight or one more rep each week. Small progress, tracked carefully over six months, transforms your body.
Read one book a month. Six books in six months, on topics that matter to you. You'll think, talk and decide very differently by the end of it.
Before: same habits, same results. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and a mind that keeps growing and sharpening every single week.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: same habits, same results. After: five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. Now my mind keeps growing every week.

slides.texte_overlay: Clean up your money. Track spending, cut useless subscriptions, start saving. Six months of control removes a huge weight from your shoulders.
Spend less time online and more outside. Walks, sports, people. Trading screen hours for real life is the quickest way to feel like a new person.
